# Netflix Jobs

> A server-rendered mirror of the Netflix careers board. Every active posting is
> a page at a stable URL, the whole board is one JSON file, and nothing here
> needs a browser to read it.

Postings are crawled from Netflix's own careers board and keep the job code
Netflix prints on them -- JR41912, AJRT30201 -- as their URL key. Applying
happens on Netflix's site, linked from the Apply button on each posting.

Fetch the board JSON once rather than crawling the listing: it is the same data
the listing filters against, in a single request. The one field it does not
carry is the full description, which lives on each posting's own page.

## Pages

- [Open roles](/): the whole active board. Filter with query parameters --
  `?team=Engineering`, `?type=Remote`, `?location=Los+Gatos`, `?q=free+text`,
  `?page=2`. Each of `team`, `type`, `location` and `q` may repeat. `type` is
  the posting's work type, which is `Onsite` or `Remote`. Every filter is in the
  URL, so any listing you can see is a link you can share.
- [A single posting](/jobs/JR41912): `/jobs/{job code}`, where the job code is
  the id printed on the posting. Case-insensitive; the canonical form is
  uppercase and anything else redirects to it. Carries the full HTML
  description, the locations, the work type, and a schema.org JobPosting as
  JSON-LD.

## Data

- [The board as JSON](/api/board): every active posting as one array, newest
  first -- job code, title, team, work type, locations and posting date.
  Business unit and the full description are on the posting page only, not here.
